source_refs.note: Book p. 282-284: 10.3 Real Life Problems, Example 9 (lighthouse, Figure 10.6) and Example 10 (projectile range)

blocks.text: Ab tak humne trigonometric equations ko kaghaz par hal kiya. Is sabaq mein hum dekhenge ke yahi maths asal zindagi mein kaise kaam aata hai: kisi cliff (oonchi chattan) ki height naapna, ya yeh tay karna ke gola kis angle par phenka jaye ke theek nishane par lage. Engineers aur architects yeh hisaab rozana karte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is section mein inverse trigonometric functions se asal sawalon ke jawab nikaalte hain: heights, angles of elevation (ooper dekhne ka angle) aur launch angles. Plan hamesha ek jaisa hota hai:
1. Figure banaiye (ya kitab ki figure parhiye) aur right angles pehchaaniye.
2. Har right triangle mein likhiye \(\tan(\text{angle}) = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}\), phir \(\tan^{-1}\) se angle ko khud likhiye.
3. Sawal ki shart (condition) ko angles ki equation mein badliye.
4. Equation hal kijiye aur sirf woh jawab rakhiye jo haqeeqat mein mumkin hon (height positive, launch angle \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(90^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan).
Example 9 mein yeh formula kaam aayega: \(\tan^{-1}\alpha - \tan^{-1}\beta = \tan^{-1}\frac{\alpha - \beta}{1 + \alpha\beta}\). Yeh do inverse tangents ke farq ko ek hi inverse tangent bana deta hai. (Yahan \(\alpha\) aur \(\beta\) dono positive hain, is liye formula bila jhijhak lagta hai.)

blocks.alt: Schematic, not to scale. A ship at B on the sea, 120 m from the foot A of a cliff. The cliff AD has unknown height h; a 15 m lantern DC stands on top of it, and a 1.5 m buoy AE stands at the foot. Red lines join B to E, D and C. Angle theta 3 is between BA and BE, theta 1 between BA and BD, theta 2 between BD and BC, and theta between BA and BC.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.6: the lighthouse, cliff, buoy and ship (original schematic drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: Pehle figure ko ghor se dekhiye. Samandar mein jahaz \(B\) par hai, cliff ki jar (base) \(A\) par. Cliff ki height \(AD = h\) maloom nahin. Cliff ke ooper 15 m ki lantern \(DC\) hai, aur cliff ki jar mein 1.5 m ka buoy (pani par tairne wala nishan) \(AE\). Jahaz se teen lines nikalti hain: \(BE\), \(BD\), \(BC\). Sawal ki asal baat yeh hai ke jahaz se dekhne par lantern jitna angle banati hai, buoy bhi utna hi angle banata hai.

blocks.title: Example 9
blocks.problem:
A lighthouse with a 15 meter tall lantern stands atop a cliff. From a ship 120 meters offshore, the lantern subtends the same angle as a 1.5 meter buoy placed at the base of the cliff.
(a) Find the exact height of the cliff.
(b) Calculate the subtended angle (\(\theta\)).
steps:
Diya gaya: lantern \(DC = 15\) m cliff \(AD = h\) ke ooper; jahaz \(B\) par, \(AB = 120\) m; buoy \(AE = 1.5\) m jar \(A\) par. Lantern ka \(B\) par angle (\(\theta_2 = \angle DBC\)) buoy ke angle (\(\theta_3 = \angle ABE\)) ke barabar hai.
Maloom karna: (a) \(h\); (b) subtended angle \(\theta_2\).
Tareeqa: sab se pehle hum dekhte hain ke cliff seedhi khari hai, is liye triangles \(ABD\), \(ABC\) aur \(ABE\) teeno \(A\) par right-angled hain. Har angle ko \(\tan^{-1}\) se likhenge, \(\theta_2\) ko do angles ka farq banayenge, phir \(\theta_2 = \theta_3\) rakh kar \(h\) nikaalenge.

Step 1: Triangle ABD
\[\tan\theta_1 = \dfrac{h}{120}\]
\[\theta_1 = \tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{h}{120}\right)\]
Kyun: triangle \(ABD\) mein \(\theta_1\) ke saamne wali side \(AD = h\) hai aur saath wali (adjacent) side \(AB = 120\). Tan hamesha opposite over adjacent hota hai.

Step 2: Triangle ABC
\[\tan\theta = \dfrac{h + 15}{120}\]
\[\theta = \tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{h + 15}{120}\right)\]
Kyun: lantern ki choti samandar se \(AC = AD + DC = h + 15\) ooper hai.
Dhyan dein: yahan sirf \(h\) likhna aam ghalti hai; lantern cliff ke ooper khari hai.

Step 3: Lantern ka subtended angle
\[\theta_2 = \theta - \theta_1\]
\[\theta_2 = \tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{h+15}{120}\right)\]
\[\qquad - \tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{h}{120}\right)\]
Kyun: lantern \(BD\) aur \(BC\) lines ke darmiyan nazar aati hai. Bara angle \(\theta\) (samandar se lantern ki choti tak) mein se cliff wala angle \(\theta_1\) nikaal dein, to sirf lantern ka angle bachta hai.

Step 4: Triangle ABE (buoy ki height 1.5 m)
\[\tan\theta_3 = \dfrac{1.5}{120}\]
\[\theta_3 = \tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{1.5}{120}\right)\]
Kyun: opposite side \(AE = 1.5\), adjacent \(AB = 120\). Aur \(\frac{1.5}{120} = 0.0125\), yeh number aage kaam aayega.

Step 5: Shart \(\theta_2 = \theta_3\) lagaiye
\[\tan^{-1}\tfrac{h+15}{120} - \tan^{-1}\tfrac{h}{120}\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\tfrac{1.5}{120}\]
Ab formula \(\tan^{-1}\alpha - \tan^{-1}\beta = \tan^{-1}\frac{\alpha - \beta}{1 + \alpha\beta}\) lagaiye:
\[\tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{\frac{h+15}{120} - \frac{h}{120}}{1 + \frac{h+15}{120}\cdot\frac{h}{120}}\right)\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{1.5}{120}\right)\]
Kyun: sawal kehta hai ke lantern aur buoy barabar angle banate hain. Formula do inverse tangents ke farq ko ek inverse tangent mein badal deta hai, taa ke dono taraf ek ek \(\tan^{-1}\) reh jaye.

Step 6: Fraction ko saada karein
Upar wala hissa: \(\frac{h+15}{120} - \frac{h}{120} = \frac{15}{120}\).
Neeche wala hissa: \(1 + \frac{h(h+15)}{14400} = \frac{14400 + h^2 + 15h}{14400}\).
\(\tan^{-1}\) one-one hai, is liye andar wali cheezein barabar:
\[\dfrac{\frac{15}{120}}{\frac{14400 + h^2 + 15h}{14400}} = 0.0125\]
\[\dfrac{15}{120}\cdot\dfrac{14400}{14400 + h^2 + 15h} = 0.0125\]
Kyun: agar do angles ke inverse tangent barabar hain to un ke tangents bhi barabar hain. \(120 \times 120 = 14400\); fraction ko fraction se divide karna yani ulta kar ke multiply karna.

Step 8: Quadratic formula
\[h = \dfrac{-15 \pm \sqrt{15^2 - 4(1)(-129600)}}{2(1)}\]
\[h = \dfrac{-15 \pm \sqrt{225 + 518400}}{2}\]
\[h = \dfrac{-15 \pm \sqrt{518625}}{2}\]
\[h = \dfrac{-15 \pm 720.2}{2}\]
Kyun: yahan \(a = 1\), \(b = 15\), \(c = -129600\). Height kabhi negative nahin ho sakti, is liye minus wala jawab chhor kar \(+\) wala lenge.
Dhyan dein: \(-4(1)(-129600) = +518400\); do minus mil kar plus bante hain.

Step 9: Cliff ki height
\[h = \dfrac{705.2}{2} = 352.6\]
Yani cliff ki height taqreeban 352.6 m hai.
Exact shakal (sawal exact height maangta hai): \(518625 = 225 \times 2305\), is liye \(\sqrt{518625} = 15\sqrt{2305}\) aur
\[h = \dfrac{15(\sqrt{2305} - 1)}{2} \approx 352.58 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{225} = 15\) root se bahar aa jata hai; \(2305 = 5 \times 461\) mein koi perfect square factor nahin, is liye yahi sab se saada exact jawab hai.

Step 10: (b) Lantern ka subtended angle
\[\theta_2 = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{367.6}{120} - \tan^{-1}\tfrac{352.6}{120}\]
\[\theta_2 = 71.92^{\circ} - 71.21^{\circ} \approx 0.72^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Step 3 mein \(h = 352.6\) rakha; \(h + 15 = 367.6\). Zyada theek values \(71.921^{\circ} - 71.205^{\circ} = 0.716^{\circ}\). (Kitab pehli value \(71.93^{\circ}\) likhti hai; neeche ghalti ka box dekhiye.)

Tasdeeq:
Kyun ke \(\theta_2 = \theta_3\), yeh angle buoy wale angle ke barabar hona chahiye:
\[\theta_3 = \tan^{-1}(0.0125) \approx 0.716^{\circ}\]
Yeh \(0.72^{\circ}\) banta hai, bilkul Step 10 jaisa. Aur \(352.58^2 + 15(352.58) \approx 129600\), yani quadratic bhi satisfy hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Part (a) mein sawal exact height maangta hai, magar kitab sirf decimal jawab \(352.6\) m deti hai (\(\sqrt{518625}\) ko \(720.2\) round kar ke). Exact height \(h = \frac{-15 + \sqrt{518625}}{2} = \frac{15(\sqrt{2305} - 1)}{2} \approx 352.58\) m hai.
Part (b) mein kitab \(\tan^{-1}\frac{367.6}{120} = 71.93^{\circ}\) likhti hai; sahi value \(71.92^{\circ}\) (\(71.921^{\circ}\)) hai. Aakhri jawab \(\theta_2 \approx 0.72^{\circ}\) durust hai: \(71.921^{\circ} - 71.205^{\circ} = 0.716^{\circ}\), jo \(\tan^{-1}(0.0125)\) ke barabar hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Angle sirf \(0.72^{\circ}\) kyun itna chhota hai? Kyun ke 15 m ki lantern 352 m ki oonchai par hai aur jahaz se door hai; door ki cheez chhoti nazar aati hai, bilkul jaise sarak par door khara khamba chhota lagta hai. Isi liye ek chhota sa buoy, jo bilkul jar mein hai, utna hi angle bana leta hai.

Is misaal ka khulasa (summary) dobara dekh lijiye, kyun ke Exercise 10.2 ke sawal 10 aur 11 bilkul isi andaz ke hain. Pehle har line ke liye ek right triangle pehchana, phir har angle ko \(\tan^{-1}\) se likha, phir sawal ki shart ko equation banaya, aur aakhir mein ek quadratic hal ki. Agar aap yeh chaar qadam yaad rakhein to kisi bhi tower, khambay ya building wale sawal mein ulajhan nahin hogi. Ek aur baat: figure par har maloom lambai likh dena aadha kaam hai, kyun ke phir har triangle ki opposite aur adjacent sides saamne nazar aati hain.

Ab doosri misaal physics se hai: projectile (hawa mein phenki hui cheez, jaise cricket ball ya gola). Jab koi cheez zameen se kisi angle par phenki jati hai to woh ek kaman (curve) bana kar kuch faasle par wapas zameen par girti hai; is faasle ko range kehte hain. Range do cheezon par depend karti hai: shuru ki raftaar (initial velocity) aur phenkne ka angle. Yahan raftaar fixed hai, is liye sirf angle badal kar range badalti hai. Humein \(\sin 2\theta = k\) qisam ki trigonometric equation hal karni hai, jo pichle sabaq (10.1) wale tareeqe se hi hal hoti hai.

blocks.title: Example 10
blocks.problem:
A projectile is launched from the ground with an initial velocity \(v_0 = 30\) m/s. The range \(R\) of the projectile is given by the formula \(R = \frac{v_0^2}{g}\sin 2\theta\), where \(\theta\) is the launch angle to the horizontal and \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^2\) is the acceleration due to gravity.
(a) Find the angle \(\theta\) (in degrees) required for the projectile to hit a target exactly 80 meters away.
(b) If the maximum range achievable is \(R_{\max} = \frac{v_0^2}{g}\), determine the angle \(\theta\) that gives the maximum range. Justify your answer mathematically.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(v_0 = 30\) m/s, \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^2\), \(R = \frac{v_0^2}{g}\sin 2\theta\); part (a) mein \(R = 80\) m.
Maloom karna: (a) woh \(\theta\) jis par \(R = 80\) m ho; (b) woh \(\theta\) jis par \(R\) sab se zyada ho, daleel ke saath.
Tareeqa: sab se pehle values formula mein rakhenge, phir \(\sin 2\theta\) ko akela karenge, aur phir \(\sin 2\theta = k\) ko un tamam angles ke liye hal karenge jo launch ke liye mumkin hain (\(0^{\circ} < \theta < 90^{\circ}\), yani \(0^{\circ} < 2\theta < 180^{\circ}\)). Range (\(R\)) matlab zameen par woh faasla jahan projectile wapas girta hai.

Step 1: (a) Values rakhiye
\[80 = \dfrac{(30)^2 \sin 2\theta}{9.8}\]
\[80 \times 9.8 = 900\sin 2\theta\]
\[784 = 900\sin 2\theta\]
Kyun: \(v_0^2 = 30^2 = 900\). Dono taraf \(9.8\) se multiply karne se fraction khatam ho jata hai.

Step 2: \(\sin 2\theta\) ko akela karein
\[\sin 2\theta = \dfrac{784}{900} = 0.8711\]
Kyun: dono taraf 900 se divide kiya. Value 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan hai, is liye solutions maujood hain. (Agar yeh 1 se zyada aati to matlab hota ke 30 m/s se target tak pohanchna namumkin hai.)

Step 3: Pehla solution
\[2\theta = \sin^{-1}(0.8711) \approx 60.59^{\circ}\]
\[\theta = \dfrac{60.59^{\circ}}{2} \approx 30.29^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\sin^{-1}\) woh angle deta hai jo \([-90^{\circ}, 90^{\circ}]\) mein ho aur jis ka sine \(0.8711\) ho. Kitab yahan \(60.5^{\circ}\) aur \(30.25^{\circ}\) likhti hai (neeche dekhiye).
Dhyan dein: calculator degree mode mein hona chahiye.

Step 4: Doosra solution
Kyun ke \(\sin\phi = \sin(180^{\circ} - \phi)\), \(0^{\circ} < 2\theta < 180^{\circ}\) mein doosra solution:
\[2\theta = 180^{\circ} - 60.59^{\circ} = 119.41^{\circ}\]
\[\theta = \dfrac{119.41^{\circ}}{2} \approx 59.71^{\circ}\]
Kyun: sine pehle aur doosre dono quadrants mein positive hai, is liye \(2\theta\) dono mein ho sakta hai. \(2\theta\) sirf \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(180^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan ho sakta hai, is liye bas yahi do mumkin hain.

Step 5: (a) ka nateeja
Projectile 80 m door target ko \(30.29^{\circ}\) ya \(59.71^{\circ}\) par phenkne se lagega (kitab: \(30.25^{\circ}\) ya \(59.75^{\circ}\)).
Kyun: dono angles ka jor \(90^{\circ}\) hai. Aise do angles (complementary) hamesha ek hi range dete hain, kyun ke \(\sin 2\theta = \sin(180^{\circ} - 2\theta) = \sin 2(90^{\circ} - \theta)\). Ek neecha aur tez safar, doosra ooncha aur lamba safar, magar girte ek hi jagah hain.

Step 6: (b) Range sab se zyada kab hogi?
Range tab sab se zyada hai jab \(\sin 2\theta\) sab se zyada ho. \(\sin 2\theta\) ki sab se bari value 1 hai:
\[\sin 2\theta = 1 \Rightarrow 2\theta = \sin^{-1}(1)\]
\[2\theta = 90^{\circ} \Rightarrow \theta = 45^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{v_0^2}{g}\) ek fixed positive number hai, is liye \(R\) bilkul usi waqt sab se bara hai jab \(\sin 2\theta\) sab se bara ho. \(0^{\circ} < 2\theta < 180^{\circ}\) mein \(\sin 2\theta = 1\) sirf \(2\theta = 90^{\circ}\) par hota hai.

Step 7: Maximum range
\[R_{\max} = \dfrac{v_0^2}{g} = \dfrac{900}{9.8} = 91.84 \text{ m}\]
Kyun (daleel): har angle ke liye \(\sin 2\theta \le 1\), is liye \(R = \frac{v_0^2}{g}\sin 2\theta \le \frac{v_0^2}{g}\), aur barabari sirf \(\theta = 45^{\circ}\) par. Yani \(45^{\circ}\) par maximum range milti hai aur koi aur angle is se zyada range nahin de sakta.

Tasdeeq:
\[R(30.29^{\circ}) = 91.84 \times \sin 60.59^{\circ} \approx 80.0\]
\[R(45^{\circ}) = 91.84 \times \sin 90^{\circ} = 91.84\]
(a) wala angle 80 m deta hai, aur \(80 < 91.84\), yani target pohanch mein hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab \(\sin^{-1}(0.8711) = 60.5^{\circ}\) leti hai. Zyada theek \(\sin^{-1}\frac{784}{900} = 60.59^{\circ}\) hai, is liye \(\theta = 30.29^{\circ}\) ya \(59.71^{\circ}\) (\(30.25^{\circ}\) par range \(79.93\) m aati hai, poore 80 m nahin).
Kitab yeh bhi kehti hai "second possible solution in \([0, 2\pi]\)" jab ke kaam degrees mein ho raha hai. Doosra solution \(0^{\circ} < 2\theta < 180^{\circ}\) se aata hai (launch angle \(0^{\circ}\) aur \(90^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan hota hai).

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin: isi projectile (\(v_0 = 30\) m/s) se 45.92 m door target ke liye angle?
\(\sin 2\theta = \frac{45.92 \times 9.8}{900} \approx 0.5\), is liye \(2\theta = 30^{\circ}\) ya \(150^{\circ}\), yani \(\theta = 15^{\circ}\) ya \(75^{\circ}\).
Tasdeeq: \(15^{\circ} + 75^{\circ} = 90^{\circ}\), complementary angles, jaisa Step 5 ne bataya.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Real life wale sawalon mein number kaatne ki aam jagahen:
1. Figure na banana ya us par maloom lambaiyan na likhna.
2. Har angle ke liye triangle ka naam na likhna (maslan "triangle ABD se"); examiner yeh dekhta hai ke aap ne sahi triangle chuna.
3. Jawab ke saath unit (m, degree) na likhna.
4. Do solutions mein se ek ko bina wajah chhor dena, ya negative height ko bina wajah bataye rakh lena. Jo jawab chhorein, us ki wajah ek line mein zaroor likhiye, maslan "height negative nahin ho sakti".
5. Rounding bohat jaldi kar dena: darmiyani steps mein kam az kam chaar decimal rakhiye, aakhir mein round kijiye.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Right triangle mein dekhne wale ka angle \(\tan^{-1}\frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}\) hota hai.
2. Kisi cheez ka subtended angle (us ki jar aur choti ki taraf lines ke darmiyan angle) do angles ka farq hota hai.
3. \(\tan^{-1}\alpha - \tan^{-1}\beta = \tan^{-1}\frac{\alpha - \beta}{1 + \alpha\beta}\) farq ko ek inverse tangent bana deta hai.
4. \(\sin 2\theta = k\) (\(0 < k < 1\)) do launch angles deta hai jin ka jor \(90^{\circ}\) hai.
5. \(R = \frac{v_0^2}{g}\sin 2\theta\) sab se zyada \(\theta = 45^{\circ}\) par: \(R_{\max} = \frac{v_0^2}{g}\).
6. Jo jawab haqeeqat mein mumkin nahin (negative height, na-mumkin angle), use chhor dein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Lantern ki choti ke liye sirf cliff ki height lena: sahi \(h + 15\) hai.
2. Quadratic ka negative root rakh lena: height hamesha positive hoti hai.
3. Example 10 mein sirf ek angle likhna: \(0^{\circ} < 2\theta < 180^{\circ}\) mein \(\sin 2\theta = k\) ke do solutions hain.
4. Pehle hi 2 se divide kar dena: pehle \(2\theta\) nikaaliye, phir 2 se divide kijiye.
5. Jawab degrees mein chahiye ho aur calculator radian mode mein rahe.
